title: Implement Safety Gate input resolver and freshness evidence policy
verify: Safety Gate resolves ActorContext, Farm/Plant scope, PlantAccessGrant, Plant state, source refs, runtime evidence, pH/EC freshness, and redaction status.
Missing, stale, conflicting, unauthorized, untrusted, out-of-scope, redaction-failed, or archived-Plant evidence fails closed or routes to missing data.
pH/EC physical-action approval freshness uses the 2-hour policy while preserving 24-hour advisory analysis separation.
evidence_required: freshness policy tests for pH/EC analysis versus physical-action approval
authorization denial and archived/revoked grant tests
constraints: Fresh evidence is required but never sufficient for physical action.
Archived Plants, revoked grants, expired ActorContext, stale evidence, and unauthorized refs fail closed.
Companion DecisionRecord may be workflow context only, never Safety Gate approval or Plant-state evidence.
invariants: Every protected safety evaluation resolves ActorContext and PlantAccessGrant before reading or mutating state.
PostgreSQL/read model remains runtime authority; timeline/UI/photo refs do not replace current state.
Stale or conflicting evidence is explicit, not silently accepted.
verification_targets: fresh pH/EC alone does not unlock approval
archived Plant or revoked PlantAccessGrant blocks eligibility
